requirement: The communication subsystem shall support connection establishment, communication progress including a blocking mode, and one-to-many scatter-style data transfers.

The send path shall defer data transmission while flow control restricts sending and resume when sending is permitted. It shall support direct access to pinned user data when direct access is enabled, and pack the payload into a send buffer otherwise.

When the embedded Libfabric verbs provider is enabled, communication shall use Linux Verbs, with librdmacm version 1.0.16 or newer for communication management and libibverbs version 1.1.8 or newer for control and data transfer.
